name: spmv
signature: void spmv(long nrows, long ncols, const long *rowptr, const long *col, const double *val, const double *x, double *y)
layout: The matrix has nrows rows and ncols columns and is stored in compressed sparse row (CSR) format: rowptr has nrows+1 elements, and the nonzeros of row i are at positions rowptr[i] to rowptr[i+1]-1 of col and val, where col holds the column index and val the value. Rows may be empty. rowptr and col are of type long. x has ncols elements and y has nrows elements. y is output only and its initial contents are undefined. No two arrays overlap. nrows and ncols are at least 1.
